Watch Chandragupta Maurya Episode - 36 now!
Synopsis :
Chanakya gives the armor to Chandragupta and asks him to keep decoding his gesticulation after arriving the arena. He disappears after speaking to Chandragupta. Soon, Chandragupta shows up in the arena for the do or die competition. The ferocity of Desmond can be witnessed by everyone. Amatya Rakshas doubts Chandragupta's capabilities, but Dhananand stays on his words that Chandragupta will survive the test. Chandragupta defies the odds and defeats Desmond after following Chanakya's gesticulation.
